# superset_annotation_layer (Resource)

Manages an annotation layer: a named group of annotations that charts can display as event markers.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "superset_annotation_layer" "releases" {
  name        = "Product releases"
  description = "One annotation per release, shown on the KPI charts"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the layer.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Free-text description of the layer.

### Read-Only

- `id` (Number) Numeric identifier of the layer.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# An annotation layer is imported by its numeric id.
terraform import superset_annotation_layer.releases 2
```
